kind: MEASURED — two fresh builds of the OAuth route's prepared directory (story 2-8c3b)
record: tree digest = sha256 of one line per entry, `<type>\t<relative path>\t<payload>\t<mode>\n`, sorted by the path's UTF-8 bytes (ablation/oauth-payload.ts `treeRecord`)
pinned: ablation/managed-host.ts OAUTH_PAYLOAD: both trees' digests are the values both runs measured
scope: two installs on one machine, one npm (11.7.0) and one node (v24.2.0), a few minutes apart: this shows the digest is stable on this machine, not that a build elsewhere, with another npm or at another time reproduces it
the digest records file bytes, execute bits and relative symlink targets; it does not record owners, timestamps or empty directories
environment: npm ran with a clean environment (scripts/oauth-prepare.ts `npmEnvironment`): PATH only from the caller, a private empty HOME with its own empty npm cache, empty user and global npm config files, and npm_config_registry https://registry.npmjs.org/. Each run therefore fetched every tarball from the registry into a fresh cache
